card.name: Revek the Spiritblade
card.text: Flying Whenever Revek attacks, put a +1/+1 on target creature token you control. Runback {3}{W}{U} (You may cast a copy of this card by exiling it from your graveyard and paying its run back cost.)

card.name: Forsake the Light
card.text: Draw three cards, then discard two cards. You gain 3 life.

card.name: The Fluke Hermit
card.text: Deathtouch, lifelink Whenever The Fluke Hermit deals combat damage to a player, mill two cards. Then draw a card if you have eight or more cards in your graveyard.

card.name: Waterways Ambush
card.text: Target player discards two cards. For each card type among cards discarded this way, create a 1/1 blue Worm creature token with "This token can't block."

card.name: Brumm, Troupe's Banisher
card.text: Menace Whenever Brumm enters or attack, you may sacrifice another artifact or creature. If you do, Brumm deals 2 damage to each opponent.

card.name: Light Up the Ritual
card.text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 2/1 black and red Bat Spirit creature token with haste. At the beginning of your step, sacrifice it unless you've descended this turn. (You descended if a permanent card was put into your graveyard from anywhere this turn.)

card.name: Elder Hu, Tending Sage
card.text: Reach At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on Elder Hu for each time you've descended this turn. (You descend each time a permanent card is put into your graveyard from anywhere.)

card.name: Pride of the Mantis Tribe
card.text: Haste Whenever this creature attacks, you may discard a card. If you do, target attacking creature gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.

card.name: The Hive Knight
card.text: Vigilance Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life. If that creature is legendary, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

card.name: The False Knight
card.text: Whenever a creature you control leaves the battlefield, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life. If that creature had a finality counter on it, draw a card. {1}, Sacrifice another creature: The False Knight gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.

card.name: Corpses of the Kingdom
card.text: Return up to two target creature cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a finality counter on each of those creatures. (If a creature with a finality counter on it would die, exile it instead.)

card.name: Uumuu, Monomon's Guard
card.text: Flying Uumuu costs {2} less to cast for each noncreature spell you've cast this turn.

card.name: Archive's Tablet
card.text: {1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw two cards. Then discard two cards. This artifact deals 2 damage to any target. Runback {2}{U}{R} (You may cast a copy of this card by exiling it from your graveyard and paying its runback cost.)

card.name: The Traitor Lord
card.text: Menace When The Traitor Lord enters, if it wasn't cast, distribute two +1/+1 among up to two creatures you control. Restless (When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control with a finality counter on it.)

card.name: Overtaken by Infection
card.text: This spell costs {2} less to cast if you control two or more permanents with counters on them. Destroy target nonland permanent.

card.name: Oro & Mato, Nailmasters
card.text: Double strike Whenever Oro & Mato attack, attach up to one target Equipment you control to them. If that Equipment was attached to another creature you control, untap that creature. It gains indestructible until end of turn.

card.name: Nailmaster's Glory
Ogrim, Dung Defender
card.text: Trample Whenever Ogrim attacks, exile target card from your graveyard. If do, put a +1/+1 counter on Ogrim and scry 1. If a land card is exiled this way, put an additional +1/+1 counter on Ogrim. (To scry 1, look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom of your library.)

card.name: Isma's Memory
card.text: When this enchantment enters, mill four cards. Release — Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard during your turn, you draw a card and gain 1 life. This ability triggers only once each turn.

card.name: The Massive Mosscharger
card.text: Trample When The Massive Mosscharger enters, create two 1/1 green Insect Plant creature tokens. The Massive Mosscharger's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
